PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Built for Specialized Work · Bespoke Design · Custom Configuration · Engineering Checks

Hubei Ouyang Jude's custom oversized-transport range uses a large gooseneck and lowered deck, as low as 950 mm, for construction machinery, concrete pump trucks, rollers, piling equipment and electrical equipment.

Our vehicle type-approval credentials and flexible production lines support the process from requirements and design to prototype development and batch delivery. High-strength steel is used for the main structural components to support reliable operation in demanding conditions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Structural Features · Built for Oversized Transport

01 GOOSENECK

Large-Gooseneck Drop Deck

The large-gooseneck frame lowers the deck to 950mm, helping accommodate tall excavators, pump trucks and piling equipment. Transport permits depend on the loaded dimensions and route.

02 MAIN BEAM

T700C High-Strength Main Beams

12 mm web plates and 10 mm flange plates are welded into T700C high-strength main beams for load capacity tailored to the application, with reinforced side beams and lower channels.

03 AXLES

Heavy-Duty Multi-Axle Layout

Approved chassis are sourced from selected domestic suppliers, with air or mechanical suspension to suit the load and operating conditions.

04 RAMP

Optional Hydraulic Ramps

Hydraulically adjustable ramps, mechanical ramps and detachable loading plates allow excavators and loaders to drive on and off, reducing handling time and reliance on lifting equipment.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers), KOMEE ABS and an emergency brake provide controlled braking on loaded descents for long-distance heavy-load transport.
